extracted.name: Dishpan Cookies
extracted.description: This recipe will literally make a dishpan full of cookies — with oats, cornflakes, pecans, and coconut. They are irresistible and perfect to share.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Cream brown sugar, white sugar, oil, eggs, and vanilla together in a large bowl. Add flour, oats, baking soda, and salt. Mix well. Stir in cornflakes, pecans, and coconut.
Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven for 8 to 10 minutes.
